argument.assign: clawdline item assign: takes one item id, got %d arguments
argument.child: clawdline item child: takes one Epic id, got %d arguments
argument.claim: clawdline item claim: takes one item id, got %d arguments
argument.doc: clawdline item doc: takes one item id, got %d arguments
argument.finish: clawdline item finish: takes one item id, got %d arguments
argument.name: clawdline item name: takes an item id and the Session's task name
argument.single_item: clawdline item %s: takes one item id, got %d arguments
argument.step_add: clawdline item step-add: takes an item id and the steps' titles
argument.two: clawdline item %s: takes an item id and one more argument, got %d arguments
error.acceptance_empty: clawdline %s: provide non-empty Markdown with --body-file or stdin. Nothing was changed.
error.add_assignment_choice: clawdline %s: --assign-self, --assign-terminal and --assign-new are one choice. Nothing was created.
error.add_required: clawdline %s: --project, --kind and --title are all required. Nothing was created.
error.assign_choice: clawdline %s: name one Session: --terminal <terminal id> or --new. Nothing was changed.
error.assign_only_new: clawdline %s: on the person's message a Session assigns an item only to a new Session (--new);
error.assign_only_new_next: to take it itself, use `clawdline item claim %s`. Nothing was changed.
error.child_assignment_choice: clawdline %s: --assign-terminal and --assign-new are one choice. Nothing was created.
error.child_required: clawdline %s: --kind and --title are both required. Nothing was created.
error.child_self: clawdline %s: --assign-self is for item add; an Epic's child can remain unassigned or use
error.created_unassigned: clawdline %s: the item was created but not assigned: %s: %s
error.doc_required: clawdline %s: --role and --title are both required. Nothing was added.
error.landing_group: clawdline %s: --commit, --target and --remote go together. Nothing was changed.
error.name_missing: clawdline item name: the daemon returned no stored Session name.
error.name_required: clawdline item name: an item id and a nonempty task name are required. Nothing was changed.
error.no_conversation: clawdline %s: cannot tell which conversation this is: none of %s is set.
error.no_conversation_next: Pass --conversation <this assistant's conversation id>. Nothing was changed.
error.no_run_answer: clawdline %s: the daemon's run answer names no run: %s
error.no_run_assign: Nothing was assigned. Without a message sent through Clawdline asking for it, leave the item for the person to assign.
error.no_run_claim: Nothing was claimed. Without a message sent through Clawdline, leave the item for the person to assign.
error.no_run_create: Nothing was created. Without a message sent through Clawdline, file a proposal
error.no_run_create_next: (POST /v1/work/v2/agent/proposals) and tell the person to accept it in the Board's Agent proposals.
error.no_step_titles: clawdline %s: no step titles, as arguments or on stdin. Nothing was changed.
error.retry: To retry the same write: clawdline %s --key %s …
error.retry_step: To retry the same write: clawdline %s --key %s %s …
error.revision_required: clawdline %s: non-empty Markdown, --run and --expected-version are required. Nothing was changed.
error.verification_worktree: clawdline %s: verification needs a branch-attached Git worktree with a readable HEAD. Nothing was changed.
flag.acceptance_file: a file holding the acceptance criteria Markdown
flag.assign_new: for add or child: assign it to a new Session Clawdline opens
flag.assign_self: for add: assign it to this Session, when the person's message asks it to do the work now
flag.assign_terminal: for add or child: assign it to the existing Session in this terminal
flag.assistant: with a new Session: claude or codex (default codex)
flag.body_file: for doc or acceptance: a file holding Markdown; - or absent reads stdin
flag.commit: for deploying (from merging, or from implementing when the verify gate is off): the landed commit
flag.conversation: this assistant's conversation id (default: from the environment)
flag.deployment: for done: what was deployed, where, which version
flag.description_file: a file holding the description; - or absent reads stdin
flag.doc: for show: print only this document's body, raw
flag.expected_version: the item's version the write expects; refused as version_conflict when it moved on (required for acceptance-revise)
flag.key: the Idempotency-Key; reuse the one printed by a failed attempt to retry it
flag.kind: feature, issue, epic, refactor or plan
flag.landing_project: for deploying: the catalog Project whose repository holds the commit, when it is not the item's
flag.model: with a new Session: the model (default the assistant's)
flag.new: for assign: a new Session Clawdline opens
flag.no_deployment_reason: for done: why nothing needs deploying
flag.no_landing_reason: for deploying: why there is no code to land (instead of --commit)
flag.persona: with a new Session: a built-in persona to open it as (none by default)
flag.project: the Project id from the catalog
flag.reference: for doc: a path in the Project, a URL, or for plan_review the review task's id
flag.remote: for deploying: the remote whose tracking target also holds it
flag.role: for doc: spec, design, test, deploy, completion_report, plan, plan_review or other
flag.run: the run of the person's message (default: this conversation's latest run)
flag.step: one step of the item, in order; repeat it for each step
flag.steps_file: a file holding the steps, one per non-empty line
flag.target: for deploying: the local target branch the commit is on
flag.terminal: for assign: the existing Session's terminal id
flag.title: the item's title
flag.verification: for merging, or deploying an ungated item: what was run to verify and what it showed
guide.acceptance: acceptance fills missing criteria once; acceptance-revise relays a person's explicit revision message;
guide.add_delegate: the registered Clawdfather may create it unassigned, then delegate to a Project Session with --assign-new or --assign-terminal;
guide.add_permission: add creates a Board item only because the person's message through Clawdline asked for one;
guide.add_self: assigns it to this Session, only when the person's message asks this Session to do the work now;
guide.add_steps: it arrives unassigned, and its --step rows are the item's steps, not to-dos; --assign-self
guide.assign_epic: assign hands a child of an Epic this Session owns to a Session (terminal ids: `clawdline guide send`),
guide.assign_new: to a new Session (--new), under that message's run; never on its own initiative;
guide.assign_permission: or, only because the person's message through Clawdline asked for it, an unassigned Feature or Issue
guide.child_assignment: feature or issue item, assigned to the Session in that terminal, to a new one, or to nobody yet;
guide.child_plan: child breaks an Epic this Session owns, after its reviewed plan (implementing or later), into a
guide.claim_limit: Clawdline told it to take that item; never on its own initiative;
guide.claim_permission: claim assigns an existing item to this Session only because the person's message through
guide.doc: doc adds a document to an item this Session owns, or revises the one with the same --role and --title
guide.doc_epic: (an item's one completion_report whatever its title; plan and plan_review are always added); an Epic needs a plan, and a plan_review
guide.doc_review: whose --reference is the id of the plan_review child that reviewed it, before implementing;
guide.finish: finish takes it from implementing onward to done in one step once its work has landed:
guide.finish_landing: the commit, target and remote come from the recorded landing unless given, and every gate still applies
guide.name: name lets an assigned new Feature Root choose its own task name once, after reading the item;
guide.persona: --persona opens that new Session as a built-in persona (`GET /v1/personas` lists them); none by default;
guide.phase: phase moves an item this Session owns one phase on, with that phase's evidence;
guide.step_add: step-add breaks an item this Session owns into ordered steps, after any it already has;
hint.verify_gate: verify gate on: this item walks verifying and merging before deploying; read "Captured planning and verification gates" in `clawdline guide board`
label.acceptance_summary: acceptance v%d sha256:%s; full text: clawdline item show %s
label.review: needs independent review (set by the person): %t
label.revision_source: requested by run %s in Session %s at %d: %s
next.assign_board: The person can assign item %s from the Board.
next.assign_child: Assign it with `clawdline item assign %s --terminal <id> | --new`, or leave it for the person.
next.claim: When the person's message asks this Session to do it, take it with `clawdline item claim %s`.
next.epic_implement: `--role plan_review --reference <task id>`, then move it to implementing. `clawdline guide epic` says how.
next.epic_plan: This is an Epic: write its plan with `clawdline item doc %s --role plan --title Plan`,
next.epic_review: have a child review it (`clawdline dispatch --kind plan_review --work-id %s --title "Review the plan" --claims ""`), record the review with
next.show: steps and documents: clawdline item show %s
persona.existing: --persona goes with a new Session, not with
persona.existing_suffix: ; an existing Session keeps the persona it was opened with.
persona.new_suffix: ; it names what the new Session opens as.
persona.unknown: --persona %q is not a persona this build has; it has %s.
result.awaiting_dialog: Board item %s is awaiting the person's first dialog in the new Project Session; no owner is assigned yet. Open that Session and answer its first screen, then check the Board.
result.created_unassigned: Board item %s was created but not assigned. The person can assign it from the Board.
result.delegation_pending: Board item %s was created; delegation outcome needs review. Check the Board before trying another assignment.
result.doc_unchanged: document %s (%s) already held this text; nothing changed, still v%d
result.partial_steps: %d of %d steps were added; the rest were not: %s
result.steps_written: wrote %d step(s); item %s is at version %d
show.no_document: clawdline item show: item %s has no document %s; %s.
text.too_large: the %s is larger than %d bytes, the most the daemon keeps for one item text
usage.acceptance: clawdline item acceptance [--body-file f | stdin] [--conversation id] [--key k] [--port n] <item id>
usage.acceptance_revise: clawdline item acceptance-revise --run id --expected-version n [--body-file f | stdin]
usage.assign: clawdline item assign (--terminal <terminal id> | --new [--assistant a] [--model m] [--persona id])
usage.claim: clawdline item claim [--run id] [--conversation id] [--key k] [--port n] <item id>
usage.doc: clawdline item doc --role <role> --title <t> [--reference r] [--body-file f | stdin]
usage.finish: clawdline item finish [--verification t] (--deployment t | --no-deployment-reason t)
usage.name: clawdline item name [--conversation id] [--port n] <item id> <Session task name>
usage.phase: clawdline item phase [--verification t] [--commit c --target b --remote r [--landing-project id] | --no-landing-reason t]
usage.show: clawdline item show [--doc <doc id>] [--port n] <item id>
usage.step_add: clawdline item step-add [--conversation id] [--key k] [--port n] <item id> <title> [<title>]… | stdin
usage.step_done: clawdline item step-done [--conversation id] [--key k] [--port n] <item id> <step id>
